source.title: Some Open Problems in Matroid Theory

trace.notes: Input URL was normalized as a zbMATH resolver record with document ID 4191653. The zbMATH API was used only for identity metadata because the zbMATH page itself is a bibliographic resolver rather than readable technical full text.

zbMATH API metadata identified the exact work as Andras Recski, "Some Open Problems in Matroid Theory", Zbl 0723.05024, Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences 555, pages 332-334, 1989. The API exposed no full-text links.

Crossref recovered DOI 10.1111/j.1749-6632.1989.tb22468.x and Wiley candidate article/PDF URLs for the same exact work. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, no best_oa_location, and no repository full text.

The DOI landing path redirected to Wiley and returned a Cloudflare challenge/403. Direct PDF and Wiley TDM download attempts did not yield a readable PDF. This was classified as blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted for the publisher source.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title with PDF, the exact title with Recski, and the exact title with the Annals citation. Inspected candidates were rejected because they were MathOverflow discussion, ScienceDirect related-article/citation pages, secondary citation pages, or the author's bibliography rather than a readable copy of this exact article.
evidence_refs: exact title plus Annals citation search

trace.notes: Source adequacy gate failed. No open problems were extracted because the available materials were resolver metadata, citation records, blocked publisher pages, search snippets, or secondary references, not readable full text containing the article's technical problem statements.
Saved JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-4191653.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
